exactText: Jared and his crew did an amazing job on our roof! From start to finish I was very impressed! Jared was very knowledgeable and communication was top notch. I couldn't recommend a better roofing company, thank you so much Jared and Swifts Roofing!

Jared was very professional! He explained everything to where I could understand better on what needed to be done. His team was extremely polite and worked very hard on our roof! Looks AMAZING! So thankful for Jared and his team! Roof looks PERFECT!

I am very happy with my roof from Swifts. It's clear from working with Jared that he cares about customer satisfaction, and will do what it takes to make sure the customer is happy. He's professional, responsive, and passionate about doing the job right. The roof looks great, and the price was very reasonable. I would highly recommend Swifts.

I’m very impressed with Swift’s Roofing. Prior to going with them I met with probably seven contractors and not only was Swift’s competitive with their estimate but they were professional and courteous with all the questions I had for my first roof replacement.

During the install, the workers were respectful and professional, worked hard throughout the day into the evening, and did a clean and quality install. They also were good about cleanup throughout the day.

After the install, the owner reviewed the installation and answered all the questions I had.

I don’t plan to need a new roof for a while but if anyone asks me for a recommendation I can easily recommend Swift’s.
Swift’s Roofing was great through the whole process with a roof replacement through my insurance. Everything went much quicker than I expected and the team was friendly and explained everything well.

The crew who replaced our roof were amazing. They worked from early morning to dark and completely cleaned up all of the mess, even though I know they had to be exhausted. Our roof looks great and we’re so thankful for getting these men to do this job for us. Bless you guy!

Swifts Roofing is absolutely the best! Jared has went above and beyond, and been a pleasure to work with. We have had 4 separate jobs done in the last year, and he has always stayed within the budget and done quality work in quick time, from delivery to tear off to putting new shingles down within a week the job is done and the roof looks so good! He is kind and professional throughout the project. I would recommend him over anyone else and I will guarantee you won’t get anyone better or a better cost!

Jared replaced my roof recently. I interviewed many roofing companies but Swifts Roofing spent a considerable amount of time evaluating my roof, taking many pictures and discussing facts with me about shingles, water movement in ice and liquid form. He spent considerable time discussing different manufacturers of roofing materials and their product differences. The bottom line with me was Jared’s time taken to evaluate my home roof. His crew really produced a beautifully done job. I was truly gratified for his clarity throughout the job. I would rate Jared 6 stars if that were an option. Thank you Jared Swift.
Jared and his crew did a quality job replacing our roof. Attention to detail in preparation, roofing, and clean up were absolutely top notch.

Update 6.5.25: Swift to the rescue, again!! Had a leak coming down an exhaust flume. Even while on an emergency call, Swift made the time to swing by promptly to check out the issue, find a fix and repair it. Not only were my concerns addressed and explained, he also repaired a few seal issues he found while working on the flue. I can't express enough how great this company is, their pricing and SWIFT responses to any roofing issues. Bravo again! Thank you so much for taking care of my roofing needs!
Thank you for everything. My ugly rusty flumes have been restored and made to match the roof color. It was also pretty awesome that you just wanted to check out and answered all the questions I had outside of the flume repair.
Thank you for the awesome work and attention to great detail. Will be calling you for all my roof needs!
